caption: The video captures a sunlit landscape view framed by dark tree trunks. A leaning trunk rises on the left while two upright trunks stand on the right, with leafy branches overhanging the top edge of the frame. Between them opens a narrow, calm water channel that stretches toward a low, bright horizon. Patches of green floating vegetation and lily pads rest on the surface, which mirrors the clear blue sky above. Dense leafy trees line both banks, converging in the distance where the open water meets a pale band of light. The view presents a tranquil composition, with the water appearing calm under even lighting and reflecting the surrounding trees.
relations: The leaning left trunk and upright right trunks frame the view, enclosing the narrow water channel.
The calm water mirrors the sky and trees, maintaining reflections unless disturbed by surface ripples.
Floating vegetation patches rest on the water, drifting slowly if gentle currents or ripples occur.
Dense leafy banks converge toward the bright horizon, keeping the channel's narrow perspective stable.
